negative_findings.reason: All CartFlows REST routes in this slice explicitly set `permission_callback` in source, so the semgrep `wp-rest-missing-permission-callback` hits are parser false positives.

Non-admin roles default to `no_access` for CartFlows capabilities in admin-core/inc/admin-helper.php:495-508, and role escalation into `cartflows_manage_settings` or `cartflows_manage_flows_steps` only occurs through the administrator-controlled role manager in admin-core/inc/global-settings.php:33-56 and admin-core/ajax/common-settings.php:368-392.

Webhook create/update/test operations are protected by `cartflows_manage_settings`, use a fixed option key, validate stored URLs, and send test requests only to previously stored validated destinations.

The unresolved IR callbacks were manually resolved to `submit_rating()` and `dismiss_nps_survey_panel()`, both of which require `manage_options` and a valid `wp_rest` nonce before any outbound request or option write.
